verdict.rationale: Cognee automatically extracts entities and builds a knowledge graph from raw text in one call, and `improve()` can consolidate short-term session memory into permanent memory. However, consolidation is an explicit call the user makes at the end of a session, not a background process, and nothing shows the system judging which facts are salient versus storing everything. missing for 10: autonomous salience filtering, background/automatic consolidation (rather than a manual improve() call), conversation-specific fact extraction docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the memory layer decides for itself what is worth remembering — extracting salient facts from raw conversation and consolidating them in the background

citations.quote: It ingests, chunks, extracts entities, and builds the knowledge graph for you in one call.
Use it at the end of a chat or agent session to bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory.
A session is Cognee's short-term memory for a specific user. It is identified by `(user_id, session_id)` and stores an ordered list of recent interactions.
